title: schoenoplectus lacustris subsp. acutus
intro: Schoenoplectus lacustris subsp. acutus, commonly known as hard-stemmed bulrush, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the cattail family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Schoenoplectus lacustris subsp. acutus include anti-spasmodic and diuretic properties, making it useful in managing digestive issues and urinary problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
